# Applications {#sec-applications}

[Informative]{.status}

This part shows the framework applied end to end. It is **informative**: nothing here adds requirements.

The two applications are deliberately different.
**Whale sightings** need information shared in real time between many participants who do not know each other.
**Recording** needs a single vessel's data captured with consistent meaning and verifiable integrity.
That one semantic model serves both is a test of the framework's design.

Each application should be traced through every binding it uses,
so it also serves as a worked example for the binding chapters.
